brief.retrievalTarget: Cord clamping raises SVR while lung aeration lowers PVR.
brief.context: Cord clamping removes the low-resistance placental circuit and raises SVR; lung aeration and oxygen lower PVR and increase pulmonary blood flow.
brief.medium: code-native SVG with PNG raster export

factBasis.fact: Cord clamping removes low-resistance placental circulation and raises systemic vascular resistance.
Lung expansion and increased oxygen lower pulmonary vascular resistance and increase pulmonary blood flow.
The combined changes reverse ductal flow toward left-to-right.

brief.wrongReadingToPrevent: Do not infer unsupported quantitative proportions or a different physiology from the abstract arrows.
